---
title: "Bubble plot — Eukaryotic classes across LMEs (healthy corals)"
author: "Joana Krause"
date: "2025-12-15"
output: html_document
---

Bubble plot of mean relative abundance (± SD) of eukaryotic classes across Large Marine
Ecosystems (LMEs) for healthy corals only. X-axis labels include per-LME sample counts.
Three concentric layers encode variability: outer halo = mean + SD, middle ring = mean,
inner core = mean − SD.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)    # do NOT load plyr — it is not used and masks dplyr::summarise
library(rlang)    # sym()
library(glue)     # glue() for dynamic titles
```

# Load phyloseq object

```{r load-ps}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../data/ps_final.rds")
ps_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4, coral_health == "healthy")
```

# Sort taxa for axis ordering

`unique()` is used directly — the previous `toString() → strsplit(", ")` approach
silently breaks whenever a taxon name contains a comma.

```{r sort-taxa}
tax.sort <- as.data.frame(ps_plas_V3_V4@tax_table) %>%
  arrange(Domain, Supergroup, Division, Subdivision, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species)

order_sorted       <- c(unique(tax.sort$Order),       "Below Threshold")
family_sorted      <- c(unique(tax.sort$Family),      "Below Threshold")
class_sorted_auto  <- c(unique(tax.sort$Class),       "Below Threshold")
division_sorted    <- c(unique(tax.sort$Division),    "Below Threshold")
subdivision_sorted <- c(unique(tax.sort$Subdivision), "Below Threshold")
genus_sorted       <- c(unique(tax.sort$Genus),       "Below Threshold")
```


# Bubble plot — Eukaryotic Classes across Large Marine Ecosystems (healthy corals)

```{r bubble-plot}
## =============================================================================
## PURPOSE:
##   Visualises the mean relative abundance of eukaryotic classes across LMEs
##   for healthy corals only, as a bubble plot.
##   Three concentric layers encode variability:
##     - Outermost halo  → mean + SD  (faint, shows upper spread)
##     - Middle ring     → mean       (semi-transparent)
##     - Inner core      → mean − SD  (solid, shows lower spread)
##
## METHODOLOGY NOTE:
##   Each sample is normalised to 100 % independently BEFORE computing group
##   summaries. This gives true per-sample relative abundances. Using
##   merge_samples() (which sums raw counts before normalising) is a known
##   phyloseq pitfall that biases both the mean and the SD — it is intentionally
##   avoided here.
## =============================================================================

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 1) USER PARAMETERS
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ps_obj         <- ps_healthy      # already filtered to healthy corals
group_var      <- "geo_loc_lme"
tax_rank       <- "Class"
mean_threshold <- 0.1             # taxa with overall mean < this % are collapsed

output_pdf <- "../output/bub/bub_healthy_lme_mean_healthy_12aug.pdf"

## X-axis group order
sample_order <- c(
  "Insular Pacific-Hawaiian",
  "Pacific Central-American Coastal",
  "Gulf of Mexico",
  "Caribbean Sea",
  "Southeast U.S. Continental Shelf",
  "Northeast U.S. Continental Shelf",
  "Bermuda",
  "Mediterranean Sea",
  "Red Sea",
  "Arabian Sea",
  "South China Sea",
  "West Central Australian Shelf",
  "Northwest Australian Shelf",
  "Indonesian Sea",
  "Micronesia",
  "Melanesia",
  "Northeast Australian Shelf",
  "Polynesia"
)

## Y-axis taxon order (bottom → top on the plot)
class_sorted <- c(
  "Below Threshold",
  "Eukaryota_XXXX",
  "Archaeplastida_XXX",
  # Chlorophyta_X
  "Ulvophyceae", "Trebouxiophyceae", "Prasino-Clade-9", "Pyramimonadophyceae",
  "Pedinophyceae", "Chloropicophyceae", "Chlorophyta_XX", "Chlorophyceae",
  "Chlorodendrophyceae",
  # Prasinodermophyta_X
  "Prasinodermophyceae", "Palmophyllophyceae",
  # Rhodophyta_X
  "Rhodophyta_XX", "Stylonematophyceae", "Florideophyceae",
  "Compsopogonophyceae", "Bangiophyceae",
  # Cryptophyta_X
  "Cryptophyceae",
  # Haptophyta_X
  "Prymnesiophyceae", "Pavlovophyceae",
  # Rhizaria - Cercozoa
  "Chlorarachniophyceae",
  # Alveolata - Apicomplexa
  "Coccidiomorphea",
  # Alveolata - Chrompodellids
  "Colpodellidea",
  # Alveolata - Dinoflagellata
  "Dinophyceae",
  # Stramenopiles - Gyrista
  "Pinguiophyceae", "Phaeophyceae", "Pelagophyceae", "Mediophyceae",
  "Gyrista_X", "Eustigmatophyceae", "Dictyochophyceae",
  "Diatomeae_X", "Coscinodiscophyceae", "Chrysophyceae", "Bacillariophyceae"
)

## Subdivision order for the fill legend
subdivision_order <- c(
  "Gyrista",
  "Chrompodellids", "Apicomplexa",
  "Haptophyta_X",
  "Cryptophyta_X",
  "Rhodophyta_X", "Prasinodermophyta_X", "Chlorophyta_X",
  "Archaeplastida_XX",
  "Eukaryota_XXX",
  "Below Threshold"
)

## Named colour palette — every level in subdivision_order has an entry.
palette <- c(
  "Gyrista"             = "#9C85C0",
  "Apicomplexa"         = "#E69F00",
  "Chrompodellids"      = "#4DAF4A",
  "Haptophyta_X"        = "#674C2A",
  "Cryptophyta_X"       = "#DDCC77",
  "Rhodophyta_X"        = "#BD0A36",
  "Prasinodermophyta_X" = "#377EB8",
  "Chlorophyta_X"       = "#ABC817",
  "Archaeplastida_XX"   = "purple4",
  "Eukaryota_XXX"       = "#00bfffff",
  "Below Threshold"     = "#999999"
)

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 2) Build x-axis labels with per-LME sample counts
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
##
## n is computed from the already-filtered ps_obj (healthy only), so it
## correctly reflects the number of healthy samples per LME.
## ifelse(..., "?", ...) guards against LME names in sample_order that are
## absent from the data — they get "(n=?)" rather than "(n=NA)".

n_df <- data.frame(geo_loc_lme = sample_data(ps_obj)[[group_var]]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(geo_loc_lme)) %>%
  dplyr::count(geo_loc_lme, name = "n")

x_labs <- setNames(
  paste0(
    sample_order, " (n=",
    ifelse(
      is.na(match(sample_order, n_df$geo_loc_lme)),
      "?",
      n_df$n[match(sample_order, n_df$geo_loc_lme)]
    ),
    ")"
  ),
  sample_order
)

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3) Melt to long format (per-sample relative abundances)
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
##
## prune_samples() drops any samples with zero total counts before normalising,
## preventing 0/0 → NaN in transform_sample_counts().

melted <- ps_obj %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = tax_rank) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%          # zero-sum sample guard
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  rename(Group = !!sym(group_var))                   # correct tidy-eval rename

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4) Mean and SD per taxon × group
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

dat1 <- melted %>%
  group_by(
    OTU, Group,
    across(all_of(tax_rank)),
    Subdivision
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abund_mean = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD         = sd(Abundance,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(SD = replace(SD, is.na(SD), 0))   # NA SD = single-sample group → 0 spread

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5) Apply threshold, re-aggregate, set factor levels, compute SD bounds
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

dat1 <- dat1 %>%
  ## Overall mean per taxon (mean of per-group means, equally weighted)
  group_by(.data[[tax_rank]]) %>%
  mutate(mean_abund = mean(Abund_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  ## Collapse rare taxa
  mutate(
    !!tax_rank  := if_else(mean_abund <= mean_threshold,
                           "Below Threshold", .data[[tax_rank]]),
    Subdivision  = if_else(mean_abund <= mean_threshold,
                           "Below Threshold", Subdivision)
  ) %>%

  ## Re-aggregate so every Group × "Below Threshold" becomes one summed row.
  ## Without this step, multiple overlapping bubbles appear instead of one,
  ## and the "Below Threshold" abundance is understated.
  ## SD is pooled in quadrature (assumes independence between taxa).
  group_by(Group, .data[[tax_rank]], Subdivision) %>%
  summarise(
    Abund_mean = sum(Abund_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD         = sqrt(sum(SD^2,  na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%

  ## Ordered factors for axes and legend
  mutate(
    Subdivision  = factor(Subdivision, levels = subdivision_order),
    tax_rank_fct = factor(.data[[tax_rank]], levels = class_sorted)
  ) %>%

  ## SD halo bounds, clamped above zero so scale_size_continuous never sees ≤ 0
  mutate(
    Abund_upper = pmax(Abund_mean + SD, 1e-6),
    Abund_lower = pmax(Abund_mean - SD, 1e-6)
  )

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 6) Bubble plot
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
##
## Three geom_point layers, drawn largest-to-smallest so inner layers are
## always visible on top:
##   Layer 1 (α = 0.20): Abund_upper — faint outer glow (mean + SD)
##   Layer 2 (α = 0.60): Abund_mean  — semi-transparent ring (mean)
##   Layer 3 (α = 1.00): Abund_lower — solid core (mean − SD)

my_title <- glue(
  "Eukaryotic {tax_rank} across Large Marine Ecosystems — healthy corals, mean ≥ {mean_threshold}%"
)

bubp <- ggplot(
  dat1 %>% filter(Abund_mean > 0),
  aes(
    x = factor(Group, levels = sample_order),
    y = tax_rank_fct
  )
) +
  geom_point(   # outermost halo: mean + SD
    aes(size = Abund_upper, fill = Subdivision, color = Subdivision),
    alpha = 0.20, shape = 21, stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_point(   # middle ring: mean
    aes(size = Abund_mean, fill = Subdivision, color = Subdivision),
    alpha = 0.60, shape = 21, stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_point(   # inner solid core: mean − SD
    aes(size = Abund_lower, fill = Subdivision, color = Subdivision),
    alpha = 1.00, shape = 21, stroke = 0
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(1e-6, 100),
    range  = c(0.1, 10),
    breaks = c(1, 10, 50, 75)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = palette, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +              # LME names with sample counts
  labs(
    x     = group_var,
    y     = tax_rank,
    size  = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill  = "Eukaryotic Subdivision",
    title = my_title
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = "none",
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))
  )

print(bubp)

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 7) Save to PDF
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

dir.create("../output/bub", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf(output_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
print(bubp)
dev.off()
```
